cyclic_prefix_controls.scope: Integer unit operations on constant-size excluded coefficient matrices, independently compared with sparse Gaussian ranks of original monomials in the full integral quotient. Composite m and primes not dividing m are included.

uniform_results.family_fan_bound: O(n^(9/4)/r), n=(s+1)^2, uniform in s,r and field
uniform_results.excluded_amplification_regime: r>=sqrt(s) implies O(n^2) full positive fan
uniform_results.cyclic_prefix_quotient: For every integer m>=2, V_D/L_< is Z^3 plus Z/m; beta changes standard membership exactly in characteristics dividing m.

scope: Finite independent exact controls support the uniform proofs in the note. A changed standard set is not a count increase. The small-order full fan, unrestricted G_3, current priority and publication significance remain open.
